def diff(f1,f2):
    a1,a2=f1.ascii.split('\n'),f2.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,c,u,v) for r,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a1,a2)) for c,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)) if u!=v]
def summ(ch):
    from collections import Counter
    t=Counter((u,v) for _,_,u,v in ch)
    return f"n={len(ch)} {dict(t)}" if ch else "n=0"
def mblocks(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); cells=[(r,c) for r in range(10,63) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='M']
    # cluster into 2x2 blocks by top-left
    tl=sorted(set((r-1,c-1) for r,c in cells))
    return tl
for (r,c) in [(36,40),(30,40)]:
    b=current_frame
    action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':r,'col':c}])
    print(f"click({r},{c}):", summ(diff(b,current_frame)), " M-blocks(top-left):", mblocks(current_frame))
    if last_action_result.get('done') or last_action_result.get('level_completed'): break

def diff(f1,f2):
    a1,a2=f1.ascii.split('\n'),f2.ascii.split('\n')
    return [(r,c,u,v) for r,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(a1,a2)) for c,(u,v) in enumerate(zip(x,y)) if u!=v]
def summ(ch):
    from collections import Counter
    t=Counter((u,v) for _,_,u,v in ch)
    return f"n={len(ch)} {dict(t)}" if ch else "n=0"
def mblocks(f):
    a=f.ascii.split('\n'); cells=[(r,c) for r in range(10,63) for c in range(64) if a[r][c]=='M']
    # cluster into 2x2 blocks by top-left
    tl=sorted(set((r-1,c-1) for r,c in cells))
    return tl
